description: The cross-implementation contract: fact record -> expected entry ids. Structure only -- see docs/adr/0006-json-schema-and-identifier-diff.md.
$comment: The top-level `jurisdiction` is the corpus default; a case may name its own, and is then evaluated against `intl` plus that jurisdiction's deltas (REQ-SCOPE-3).

expectItem.$comment: Q-5, decided in pencil 2026-09-04: a bare entry id asserts nothing about modality; `{entry, modality}` names the modality that entry is expected to carry once `modality_by` and `modality_shifts` have been applied. The two forms are interchangeable, so no published case needed migrating.

facts.$comment: A FactRecord (schema/fact-record.schema.json, ADR 0014); a case asserts at least one fact.
